北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京体感 -4℃，注意保暖，别冻着了哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing feels like -4℃, stay warm and don't catch a cold!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪体感 -2℃，风力 3级。出门多穿点，注意防风。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi feels like -2℃ with 3-level winds. Dress warmly and mind the wind.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海体感 0℃，微风舒适。别忘了加件外套哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai feels like 0℃ with a gentle breeze. Don't forget your jacket!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴朗体感 7℃，有风。早晚温差大，注意添衣！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny, feels like 7℃ with wind. Mind the temperature changes, dress appropriately!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗体感 11℃，舒适。记得多喝水，保持好心情！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny, feels like 11℃, comfortable. Remember to hydrate and stay cheerful!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州体感 -1℃，晴朗微凉。多穿点，暖暖和和过一天。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou feels like -1℃, sunny and cool. Dress warmly for the day.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京体感 -1℃，晴朗无风。虽然无风，也要注意保暖哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing feels like -1℃, clear and no wind. Stay warm even without wind.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都小雨体感 1℃，湿度 100%。出门带伞，防潮保暖哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu has light rain, feels like 1℃, 100% humidity. Bring an umbrella, stay dry and warm.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾体感 -2℃，注意安全。多穿衣服，别感冒了。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy, feels like -2℃. Drive safely. Dress warm to avoid colds.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天体感 -4℃，很冷。多穿几层，暖和最重要。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels like -4℃, very cold. Layer up, warmth is key.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天体感 4℃，有风。风大体感凉，多穿点哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels like 4℃ with wind. It's chilly with the wind, dress warmly!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 -20℃，超级冷！务必全副武装，保暖第一。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -20℃, extremely cold! Bundle up completely, warmth is top priority.
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -20℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳体感 -21℃，冰冷。帽子手套不能少，穿厚点。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang feels like -21℃, icy. Dress warmly, don't forget hats and gloves.
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -21℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗体感 10℃，舒适宜人。享受阳光，保持好心情。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny, feels like 10℃, pleasant. Enjoy the sunshine and stay cheerful.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门体感 3℃，风力 5级。风很大，出门注意防风保暖。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen feels like 3℃ with 5-level winds. It's very windy, mind the wind and stay warm.
厦门.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛体感 -6℃，风力 3级。风寒效应强，出门裹严实哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao feels like -6℃ with 3-level winds. Strong wind chill, bundle up tight!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连体感 -7℃，多云。天气冷，多穿衣，别着凉了。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian feels like -7℃, cloudy. It's cold, dress warmly to avoid catching a cold.
